institution.name: UNESCO and The World Academy of Sciences (TWAS)

qualifications: African scientists based at recognized universities or research institutions in Africa
Research in the natural sciences interrupted by conflict or by natural or biological hazards
description_short: Under UNESCO's Science for Crisis Response and Solutions Programme, six grants of up to USD 2,000 each help African scientists at African institutions resume or complete natural-sciences research interrupted by conflict or natural or biological hazards. Deadline: 15 November 2026.
